Send message

S20.01.note: The renderer also turns a single line break into a line break (breaks: true in markdown.ts), so single newlines show as new lines, not as new paragraphs.
steps: Open the AGI side panel in Chrome and sign in if asked.
Click the box "How can I help you today?", type: Write two short paragraphs about the weather, with a blank line between them.
Click "Send message" (the send button).
When the answer finishes, look for two separate blocks of text with space between them, as in Expected.
S20.01.where: Side panel (signed in) > type in "How can I help you today?" > Send message

steps: Click the box "How can I help you today?".
Type: Answer with a # heading, a ## heading and a ### heading, each over one line of text.
Click "Send message".
Check that the heading lines are shown as larger, bold headings and that no # symbols are visible.

Click "Stop response" while the code is still open and check that it stays as a code block, not as normal text.
